data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my to-do list","i_want":"to edit an existing task","so_that":"I can keep the task details accurate","business_description":"The user opens an existing task in the task form, changes its fields and saves. The backend validates the update and the frontend shows the result only after the backend responds.","business_value":"Task data stays accurate without deleting and re-creating tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title cannot be longer than 100 characters is shown"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user enters a title of exactly 100 characters and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and returns success"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend
